summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Sudhanshu Ranjan portfolio. All 6 backend pytest tests pass (root, projects, contact create+persist, invalid email 422, empty fields 422, missing fields 422). All frontend critical flows verified: Hero renders with name and 3 buttons, navbar navigation scrolls to sections, 10 project cards fetched from /api/projects, project modal opens & closes, all 9 sections present (#about, #skills, #projects, #ai-ml, #github, #journey, #dsa, #certifications, #contact), contact form empty-submit shows validation toast, valid submit shows success toast and clears fields, mobile nav toggle opens menu and links scroll correctly.

issues: Hero heading 'Sudhanshu Ranjan' appears to overflow horizontally on 390px viewport — page has slight horizontal scroll. Consider reducing hero font-size on small screens or adding overflow-x:hidden to body.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Tighten mobile hero typography to prevent horizontal overflow at 390px width.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: PROJECTS list is referenced inside get_projects() but defined below the route definition — works at runtime due to lazy lookup but readability suffers; move PROJECTS above its consumer.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') (FastAPI lifespan handlers are now preferred).
POST /api/contact returns 200 (FastAPI default) instead of 201 Created — acceptable but 201 would be more RESTful.
GET /api/contact has no auth — exposes all contact submissions publicly. Should be admin-protected in production.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — this combination is invalid per CORS spec; browsers reject credentials with wildcard.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ contact message via POST /api/contact during persistence test (id auto-generated).
